output.reason: Two days of black tarry stools with lightheadedness on standing suggests ongoing GI bleeding with possible significant blood loss, requiring immediate emergency assessment, labs and possible transfusion or endoscopy that messaging cannot provide.
output.patientMessage: Go to the emergency department now. Black, tarry stools plus feeling lightheaded when you stand can mean active bleeding in your gut with meaningful blood loss, which needs blood tests and urgent assessment today. Have someone drive you rather than driving yourself. Call 911 instead if you faint, vomit blood, or become confused, very weak, or short of breath.
